WIN32_SDL_DRIVER.doc: SDL3 implementation of the shared Win32 GUI driver's drawing and input.

members.name: load
members.doc:
`load paths` loads generated SDL libraries and initializes owning-thread video.

The selected M9 support functions suppress automatic quit on window close.

members.name: shutdown
members.doc: `shutdown ()` quits and unloads SDL after every driver window closes.
